---
title: "Text"
format: html
extensions:
  support-this:
    display: text
    description: "Your support keeps this work going."
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: coatless
      ko_fi: coatless
      buy_me_a_coffee: coatless
filters: [support-this]
---

With `display: text`, each link is just the platform's name, with no icon or account. It suits a short list or a formal document.

Because the account isn't shown, several accounts on the same platform all read the same. If you list more than one per platform, pick another display mode.

## Configuration

```yaml
extensions:
  support-this:
    display: text
    description: "Your support keeps this work going."
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: coatless
      ko_fi: coatless
      buy_me_a_coffee: coatless
filters: [support-this]
```

## Other formats

RevealJS, Typst, Word, and PDF show the same links, with each platform's name in bold.

The other display modes are [Icon, Platform & Username](qsupport-this-display-icon-platform-username.qmd), [Icon & Username](qsupport-this-display-icon-username.qmd), and [Badges](qsupport-this-display-badge.qmd).
